title: n-dimensional growth of the Hausdorff measure of a compactly contained C^1 graph piece
statement: Let n >= 1, l >= 0, 0 < rho < R, and u : R^n -> R^l C^1 on the open ball Bo_R(0). Then there is a constant C >= 0 such that for every z in R^(n+l) and every r > 0, H^n(graphOver u (Bo_rho(0)) cap B_r(z)) <= C r^n, where H^n = muHE[n], Bo is the open and B_r(z) the closed ball.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (R ρ : ℝ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), 0 < ρ → ρ < R → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 R) → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (z : Amb n ℓ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (graphOver u (ball 0 ρ) ∩ closedBall z r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ n)
